name: plasticdetox-app
description: Plastic Detox iOS app: scan or search a product, get the four front verdict.

scripts.bundle: node scripts/sync-data.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs && python3 ../tools/audit-links.py --strict && node scripts/bundle.mjs
scripts.ios: npm run sync-data && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.archive: npm run sync-data && npx cap copy ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -archivePath dist/ios/PlasticDetox.xcarchive archive
